chunks: 4916 - And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

It was said to 'Isa ibn Maryam, peace be upon him: “What is the matter with you that you do not marry?” So he said: “What would I do with marriage?” They said: “Children would be born to you.” He said: “What would I do with children? If they live, they cause trial; and if they die, they cause sorrow.”

key_terms.عِيسَى: 'Isa (Jesus), the prophet being addressed in the report
key_terms.فَتَنُوا: they cause trial or become a source of tribulation

ai.seo_question: Why did 'Isa ibn Maryam عليه السلام say that he did not marry?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a saying attributed to 'Isa ibn Maryam عليه السلام about abstaining from marriage and children due to the trials and sorrows attached to worldly attachments. It highlights an ascetic ethical perspective rather than a legal ruling, emphasizing detachment from worldly burdens.
